scope: Original Tree UID/preparation/computed node/link hooks, creation/transition/key/handler recipes, default Node/Link/Label JSX and actual default Canvas command functions. Hierarchy traversal input and numeric root coordinates/scales/colors/React hooks/JSX/Spring/path generators are explicit authored dependency probes. No D3 tree numerical, React/Spring scheduling, native Canvas property validation, browser input, live Glory state or framebuffer equivalence.

execution.Nodes.tsx:Nodes:
const Nodes = <Datum,>({
    nodes,
    nodeComponent,
    isInteractive,
    onMouseEnter,
    onMouseMove,
    onMouseLeave,
    onMouseDown,
    onMouseUp,
    onClick,
    onDoubleClick,
    setCurrentNode,
    tooltip,
    tooltipPosition,
    tooltipAnchor,
    margin,
}: NodesProps<Datum>) => {
    const { animate, config: springConfig } = useMotionConfig()

    const transition = useTransition<ComputedNode<Datum>, NodeAnimatedProps>(nodes, {
        keys: node => node.uid,
        from: regularTransition,
        enter: regularTransition,
        update: regularTransition,
        leave: leaveTransition,
        config: springConfig,
        immediate: !animate,
    })

    return (
        <>
            {transition((animatedProps, node) =>
                createElement(nodeComponent, {
                    node,
                    isInteractive,
                    onMouseEnter,
                    onMouseMove,
                    onMouseLeave,
                    onMouseDown,
                    onMouseUp,
                    onClick,
                    onDoubleClick,
                    setCurrentNode,
                    tooltip,
                    tooltipPosition,
                    tooltipAnchor,
                    margin,
                    animatedProps,
                })
            )}
        </>
    )
};

boundaries.publicApi: Actual nodeComponent/linkComponent/labelComponent plus Canvas renderNode/renderLink/renderLabel. No synthetic node prop or per-mark custom layer equivalence.
boundaries.raw: Original node.data references original nested objects, including extra metadata and signed zero; computed node raw value is not a hierarchy aggregate field. Rust flat globally unique identity/aggregate scalar differs.
boundaries.identity: Original nodes use dot-joined ancestry UID and links sourceUID:targetUID. Dotted raw IDs can collide; collision is preserved, not repaired here.
boundaries.eligibility: Parent layers gate; every transitioned node/link is created including zero size, zero thickness and noninteractive. Default event handlers alone are gated by isInteractive.
boundaries.animation: Nodes leave sets size0. Links leave retains full thickness/color/endpoints, unlike some other Nivo families. No live Spring retirement or interpolation executed.
boundaries.labels: Default Label renders computed label.label through themed Text and animated group transforms. These are authored computed-label probes, not full useLabels numeric layout or this round live labelComponent implementation.
boundaries.canvas: Actual functions set fill/stroke style, node radius=size/2 and lineWidth=thickness, then invoke arc/fill or supplied linkGenerator/stroke. Existing globalAlpha,lineCap are not overwritten; native invalid zero width behavior is not emulated.
